verdict.rationale: A probe found an official MCP server in Raygun's parent organization's GitHub repo (MindscapeHQ/mcp-server-raygun), so agents can connect to Raygun through a first-party MCP server. The evidence is a single probe pointer with no detail on what the server exposes or how it is set up. Missing for 10: documentation of the MCP server's tools and capabilities, setup and authentication details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
